functionalSummary: Created ESP32 firmware foundation including motor driver implementations (RMD-X, RH, CEM, RMD-H, FL, RMD-L) and RS485 protocol class, along with core type definitions and configuration headers.
detailSummary: Work focused on establishing ESP32 firmware structure by creating motor driver implementations for six motor series (RMD-X, RH, CEM, RMD-H, FL, RMD-L) and an RS485 protocol class. Each driver follows a consistent pattern: header file declares class extending IMotorDriver interface, implementation file includes standard headers (config.h, constants.h, Arduino.h) and provides method implementations. Core infrastructure files (types.h, config.h, constants.h) were created to support the drivers with type definitions, pin mappings, and physical constants. The ESP32_FIRMWARE_CONTRACT.md was created as a reference document. However, the original todo item requested CAN, RS485, and EtherCAT protocol implementations - only RS485 header was created, while CAN and EtherCAT implementations remain incomplete. The work established a foundation but requires build system updates and compilation verification.
keyPatterns: Naming: PascalCase for classes (RMDXDriver, RHDriver), snake_case for methods and variables
Structure: Each driver has .h (interface) and .cpp (implementation) in src/drivers/
Headers: Use #pragma once, include motor_driver.h or pal.h as base
Includes: Implementation files consistently include config.h, constants.h, and Arduino.h
Inheritance: Motor drivers extend IMotorDriver, protocols extend IProtocol
Constants: Defined in constants.h with #define macros (PI, DEG_TO_RAD, etc.)
Config: Pin mappings and hardware config in config.h with #define
verification: No build verification performed; files created but compilation not tested
unresolved: CAN protocol implementation not started (only can_bus.h read)
RS485 protocol header created but implementation file (.cpp) not created
No build system configuration updated to include new source files
No tests written for any of the new drivers or protocols
